findings.current: where only thirty-two Great Chieftains were permitted to sit
findings.defect: The draft promotes ordinary tribal chieftains to Great Chieftains, changing the council’s stated hierarchy.
findings.rationale: The source uses 부족장, not the established higher title 대족장.
findings.replacement: where only thirty-two tribal chieftains were permitted to sit
findings.source: 서른두 명의 부족장만이 자리할 수 있는 대회의에 참석한

findings.current: Their faces trembled like aspens, and an indelible terror lingered there.
findings.defect: The draft makes the warriors’ faces tremble, whereas the source says their bodies are trembling and terror is visible on their faces.
findings.rationale: 몸 is the subject of 떠는, while 얼굴 carries the ensuing description of fear.
findings.replacement: Their bodies trembled like aspens, and their faces bore an indelible terror.
findings.source: 사시나무처럼 몸을 떠는 그들의 얼굴에는 지울 수 없는 공포가 깃들어 있었고

findings.defect: The English onomatopoeia depicts spitting, an action absent from the source.
findings.rationale: 푸하 marks Baeksang catching or releasing his breath after the muffled sounds, not spitting.

findings.current: She suffered terribly because of her useless father and lost two older brothers.
findings.defect: The coordination weakens the source’s causal statement that her father was responsible for her losing two older brothers.
findings.rationale: 때문에 governs the loss and consequent suffering, making the father’s guilt central to Yayul Cheok’s grief.
findings.replacement: Because of her worthless father, she lost two older brothers and suffered terribly.
findings.source: 못난 애비 때문에 오라비를 둘이나 잃고 많이 힘들어했어.

findings.current: As always, Baeksang asked a question to which no answer would return, then stared at the mirror blurred with moisture.
findings.defect: The added word “moisture” explicitly identifies the cause of the blurred reflection before the source’s raindrop metaphor reveals that Baeksang is crying.
findings.rationale: The source only calls the mirror 뿌옇게 물든, deliberately withholding the tears that the following lines represent as rain.
findings.replacement: As always, Baeksang asked a question that would receive no answer, then stared at the mirror, now gone hazy.
findings.source: 언제나 그렇듯, 대답이 돌아오지 않는 물음을 던진 백상은 뿌옇게 물든 면경을 바라보았다.

findings.current: She ruptured the dead man’s testicles, showered him with every curse imaginable, and hacked his corpse to pieces.
findings.defect: The clinical wording “ruptured the dead man’s testicles” sanitizes the deliberately crude, comic register of 죽은 놈 불알을 터트리고.
findings.rationale: 불알 and 놈 are blunt and vulgar here; the coarse description drives the contrast with the father’s image of his frail, beautiful daughter.
findings.replacement: She crushed the dead bastard’s balls, hurled every curse imaginable at him, and hacked his corpse to pieces.
findings.source: 그러고도 분이 안 풀렸는지 이미 죽은 놈 불알을 터트리고, 온갖 욕설을 퍼부으면서 시신을 난도질해 놨다고 했소.

findings.current: Why are you speaking informally? Go prepare for the wedding of those youngsters who are crazy about each other.
findings.defect: The draft explains the speech-level joke generically instead of preserving the pointed rebuke to Baeksang’s specific informal “What?”
findings.rationale: 뭐는 반말이고 directly mocks the preceding 뭐?, producing a terse hierarchy-based joke.
findings.replacement: Don’t ‘what’ me. Just get ready to marry off those youngsters who are crazy about each other.
findings.source: ‘뭐는 반말이고. 서로 좋아 죽는 어린 것들 혼례 치를 준비나 하라고.’

findings.current: “What kind of nonsense is this? How could that possibly be allowed?”
findings.defect: “Allowed” turns the speaker’s disbelief about plausibility into a question about permission.
findings.rationale: 가당키나 한가 challenges whether the claim is credible or reasonable, not whether someone permits it.
findings.replacement: “What kind of nonsense is this? How could that possibly be true?”
findings.source: “이 무슨 말도 안 되는! 그게 가당키나 한가!”

findings.defect: “A pair of double axes” is redundant and may suggest two double-headed weapons rather than the source’s paired axes.
findings.rationale: 쌍부 denotes two axes used as a pair; the source does not specify double-headed axe blades.

findings.current: In Hwi’s words, it was like watching an imperial palace chef mince meat with demonic skill.
findings.defect: “Demonic skill” introduces a specifically evil quality absent from 신들린 솜씨 and distorts the comic comparison.
findings.rationale: 신들린 솜씨 means inspired or uncannily masterful technique, not demonic technique.
findings.replacement: In Hwi’s words, it looked like an imperial palace chef mincing meat with uncanny skill.
findings.source: 휘아의 표현을 빌리자면 황궁 숙수가 신들린 솜씨로 고기를 다지는 것 같았다던데.

findings.current: the woman— the Southern Heaven Demon Empress—smiled broadly.
findings.defect: The space after the opening em dash violates the required closed-em-dash formatting.
findings.rationale: The binding Markdown rules require em dashes without surrounding spaces.
findings.replacement: the woman—the Southern Heaven Demon Empress—smiled broadly.
findings.source: 백상의 부름에 여인, 남천마후는 활짝 웃었다.

summary: The draft contains one altered physical action, one added action, several hierarchy and causal-fidelity issues, and localized losses of humor, register, and deliberate ambiguity.
